items.text: Lamar Jackson questionable to return vs Titans with ankle injury; Huntley in at start of 3rd.
items.implication: Monitor closely; backup in, fantasy points at risk rest of game.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase ruled OUT due to concussion after evaluation in Bengals-Jaguars game.
items.why: Concussion from big hit; will not return.
items.implication: Remove immediately; opens targets for Higgins and others rest of game/ROS risk.

items.text: Saquon Barkley downgraded to OUT with hamstring injury after early exit vs Rams.
items.why: Hamstring pull on early carry; examined then ruled out.
items.implication: Zero remaining production; Eagles backfield depleted further with OL issues.

items.text: ETR weekend summary: EXPECTED Puka Nacua, Zay Flowers, Ladd McConkey, Tyjae Spears; GTD Mike Evans; NOT EXPECTED Jalen Coker, Terry McLaurin, Keenan Allen; Bagent starting.
items.implication: Core Sunday status board for lineup locks/sits.

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin (hamstring) officially inactive vs Colts in London.
items.why: Hamstring suffered late in week practice.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; targets redistribute in WAS offense missing Daniels too.

items.text: Rams do not intend to limit Puka Nacua’s workload vs Eagles; Nacua active and returning from hip/groin.
items.why: Sources confirm no workload restriction planned.
items.implication: Full snap/route share expected; strong WR1 upside in depleted Eagles secondary matchup.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active (foot/ribs); Derwin James inactive hamstring.
items.why: Cleared despite recent limited practices and prior rib issue.
items.implication: Playable but docked; monitor snap share.
items.conflict: Levitan notes bigger dock on foot/ribs

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans officially active despite rib injury; optimistic and practiced late week.
items.why: Practiced, said will do best; team optimistic though ribs suck.
items.implication: Start with dock for possible pitch count/pain.
items.opportunity: Targets if limited Kittle or others

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder) downgraded from questionable to doubtful to return.
items.implication: Unlikely more production; Bills WR depth tested.

items.text: Raiders fully expecting Brock Bowers to play vs Chiefs despite added illness (prior knee).
items.why: Illness noted but team expects him in.
items.implication: TE1 lock if active; monitor pregame.

items.text: Eagles OT Lane Johnson inactive (personal reasons); rookie Markel Bell starts RT; backup Fred Johnson also out. Eagles 18-29 without him historically.
items.implication: Eagles OL further depleted (with Smith/Goedert out); hurts Hurts/Saquon (already out) protection/run game.

items.text: Commanders QB Marcus Mariota (knee) downgraded to OUT (w/ Daniels already out).
items.implication: WAS third-string QB; major fade on remaining skill players volume/efficiency.

items.text: Small dock only on Puka Nacua (groin) now that Rams intend no workload limit per Schefter; tinier on Flowers; bigger on McConkey/Evans.
items.why: Updated projections post-Schefter no-limit report; practice trends.
items.implication: Nacua near full projection; caution McConkey/Evans usage.
items.opportunity: Nacua routes/carries unrestricted; Flowers no hard pitch count

items.text: Nico Collins excellent return spot (Cowboys inflate WR scoring most in NFL +7.3%); Eagles without Smith/Goedert/Baun (now +Johnson); Jordan Addison home smash vs weak secondary with JJ out.
items.why: DvP data, injury cascade, matchup for Addison.
items.implication: Start Collins confidently; fade Eagles pass catchers somewhat; Addison must-start opportunity.
items.opportunity: Collins targets vs soft secondary; Addison 100% snap/route share

items.text: Prior ETR list: IN Nacua/Collins/Swift/Irving/Pollard etc; Q McConkey/Flowers/McLaurin/Evans/Spears etc; OUT Caleb Williams/Jayden Daniels/Mayfield/JJ/Breece/Devonta/Goedert/Achane/Jadarian Price etc.
items.implication: Baseline for actives; many key OUT create opportunities (Addison, backups).

items.text: Lamar added to early exits (w/ Saquon/Chase/DJ Moore/Mariota); two Bhayshul Tuten TDs called back by penalty; Austin Ekeler looks good returning.
items.why: Live game observation on injuries and usage.
items.implication: Tuten near-misses frustrating but role confirmed; Ekeler positive return sign.

items.text: Tinier dock on Zay Flowers (hamstring); not expected hard pitch count per beat.
items.why: Beat report no hard limit; ETR expected.

items.text: Baker Mayfield dislocated thumb expected to sideline 3-6 weeks depending on grip recovery.
items.why: Sources on thumb dislocation recovery timeline.
items.implication: TB QB change; impacts Godwin/Evans/Irving longer term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming or fade TB skill
